description: 苏格兰开局 C45 — 综合演示：多线同时打开，Bg2象控长对角线

intro.popup_en: Line Control, Lesson 5: A complete example of several lines opening together. The bishop on g2 will control a long diagonal while the rook occupies the d-file, creating coordinated pressure.
intro.popup:
线路控制第5课
综合演示：多线同时打开
Bg2控长对角线
d线+斜线立体配合

outro.popup_en: The d-file and the bishop's long diagonal work together: Bg2 targets b7 while the rook on d1 controls the d-file. Coordinating several open lines is an advanced form of line control.
outro.popup:
综合总结
d线和g2斜线同时打开
Bg2直指b7，d1车控d线
多线协同，这是高级复杂的线路控制

moves.popup_en: e4 occupies the center and begins the Scotch Game.
moves.popup:
e4占中心
苏格兰开局序列开始

moves.popup_en: ...e5 replies symmetrically and occupies the center.
moves.popup:
e5对称应对
黑方占据中心

moves.popup_en: Nf3 develops and attacks e5.
moves.popup:
Nf3发展马
攻击e5

moves.popup_en: ...Nc6 develops and protects e5.
moves.popup:
Nc6保护e5
黑方发展

moves.popup_en: d4! The key move of the Scotch Game immediately challenges the center.
moves.popup:
d4！苏格兰核心
立刻挑战中心
这是苏格兰开局的关键步骤

moves.popup_en: ...exd4 exchanges in the center and opens the e-file. The d4-square becomes a new point of contention.
moves.popup:
exd4兑换
e线打开！
同时d4格成为争夺目标

moves.popup_en: Nxd4 occupies the center with a knight. The knight on d4 gives White strong central control.
moves.popup:
Nxd4马占中心
d4格强马
白方中心控制

moves.popup_en: ...Nf6 develops and attacks e4, creating counterpressure.
moves.popup:
Nf6出马
攻击e4
黑方反压

moves.popup_en: Nc3 supports e4 and strengthens White's central setup. White's minor-piece development is nearly complete.
moves.popup:
Nc3发展
支持e4，加强中心
白方轻子发展完成

moves.popup_en: ...Bc5 develops to an active diagonal, a typical response in the Scotch Game.
moves.popup:
Bc5发展象
黑方主动斜线
苏格兰中的典型应对

moves.popup_en: Be3! White challenges the bishop on c5 and develops toward a setup with queenside castling and a kingside attack. The move also prepares the bishop's fianchetto route.
moves.popup:
Be3！挑战c5象
同时开放g2的斜线方向
白方布局指向长易位+王翼进攻

moves.popup_en: ...Bb6 retreats and avoids the exchange, preserving the bishop's activity.
moves.popup:
Bb6撤退
黑方避免兑换
保留象的活动性

moves.popup_en: Qd2! Be3 and Qd2 coordinate to prepare queenside castling. White's king will move away from the kingside before the attack begins.
moves.popup:
Qd2！苏格兰攻击布阵
Be3+Qd2是配对——
下一步O-O-O长易位
王翼攻击即将开始

moves.popup_en: Black castles kingside. White is preparing to castle long, after which Black will face a kingside attack.
moves.popup:
黑方王车易位
王躲王翼
黑方面临白方长易位后的王翼攻击

moves.popup_en: O-O-O! White castles long and activates the rook on d1. The d-file is semi-open, and White can immediately use it while preparing a kingside pawn advance with f3 and g4.
moves.popup:
O-O-O！白方长易位
王躲后翼，车到d1！
d线半开放，Rd1立刻有活力
同时白方准备f3-g4王翼进攻

moves.popup_en: ...d6 stabilizes Black's center and prepares defense.
moves.popup:
d6稳固中心
黑方防守

moves.popup_en: f3 supports e4 and prepares g4, advancing White's kingside attack.
moves.popup:
f3巩固e4
同时为g4做准备
白方王翼推进计划中

moves.popup_en: ...Be6 challenges the knight on d4 and prepares an exchange to simplify the position. Black also seeks active play.
moves.popup:
Be6挑战d4马
黑方准备兑换以简化
黑方开始争取主动

moves.popup_en: g4! White pushes the kingside attack forward. Black's central counterattack is approaching.
moves.popup:
g4！王翼推进
白方加速攻击
黑方中心反击即将到来

moves.popup_en: ...d5! Black counterattacks in the center, attacking e4 and challenging White's kingside advance. The position is about to open several lines at once.
moves.popup:
d5！黑方反击中心！
攻击e4，反制白方王翼推进
局面进入爆炸阶段——多线即将同时打开

moves.popup_en: exd5! The position opens explosively. The d-file points toward d5 and d8 for White's rook, the g2-b7 diagonal can open for the bishop, and the e-file is partly open as well. Several lines are becoming active at once.
moves.popup:
exd5！多线同时打开！
→ d线：d1车直接看向d5、d8
→ g2斜线：将来Bg2可控制整条斜线
→ e线也部分打开
这是一次爆炸性兑换！

moves.popup_en: ...Nxd5 recaptures and places a knight on the strong central square. The fight for central control continues.
moves.popup:
Nxd5黑方重提
马占d5强格
中心控制权争夺激烈

moves.popup_en: Nxd5! White's knight from c3 removes the strong knight on d5. The exchange clears more lines for White's pieces.
moves.popup:
白方马Nc3xd5！
清除d5强马
斜线进一步打开

moves.popup_en: ...Bxd5 recaptures and completes the exchange on d5. The resulting position defines the diagonal from g2 toward b7, which White's bishop can soon occupy.
moves.popup:
Bxd5黑方象重提
d5格换子完成
g2-b7斜线的格局已确定
白方Bg2将控制整条对角线

moves.popup_en: Bg2! White's bishop controls the long diagonal and directly targets b7, while the rook on d1 controls the d-file. This is the culmination of A4: multiple lines open and several pieces join them at once.
moves.popup:
Bg2！综合演示终点
象到g2，控制g2-a8长对角线
直接威胁b7！
同时Rd1控制d纵线
→ 纵线+斜线 立体协同
→ 这是A4线路控制的最高表达！
多线同时打开，多子立刻参战
